description: List every Qualcomm AI Hub device EdgeGate can target (Snapdragon phones, QRD/CRD reference platforms, IoT Dragonwing, automotive, XR). Returns a markdown table grouped by category. Use the `id` column verbatim when building a `create_pipeline` device matrix. No workspace_id needed — the catalog is global.

category.description: Optional form-factor filter. Omit to return the full catalog grouped by category.

name: edgegate_list_devices
